paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: keeps the session skill catalog out of every request — skills are listed on demand, the
ones a task needs are recorded once, and only a picked skill is loaded by name.
# dsh-skill-on-demand
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness injects every installed skill's full description into each request. With dozens of
skills that is tens of thousands of tokens re-sent every turn, most of it about skills the task neve
r touches. Removing the catalog outright saves the tokens but makes skills invisible: the model stop
ving the catalog outright saves the tokens but makes skills invisible: the model stops calling them.
This plugin lands in the middle: a **one-line index** of every skill (name + a short clause from its
description), injected once per session, and full instructions loaded only on demand.
## What it does
| Before | With this plugin |
| Full 500-char description per skill, re-sent every turn | One line per skill (`name: <28-char clau

se>`), once per session |
| Nothing searchable mid-session | `skill_list query=关键词` ranks the full d

escriptions and returns the closest matches |
| Nothing records what a task uses | `skill_pick` opti

onally records the chosen skills |
| Every body reachable but unmeasured | `skill` loads exactly one
full body, by name |
The index is about a third of the full catalog, so the model can still read what each skill does; th
e expensive full descriptions and bodies stay out until needed.
## How the full catalog is removed
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill` publishes its catalog only while `ctx.tools.get('skill', agent)` resol
ves to its own tool registration. This plugin registers a same-name `skill` tool in each agent's own
scope (the nearest scope wins), so that check fails and the catalog stops being published. The repl
acement tool does the same job — load one skill's instructions by exact name.
Presets that never mounted a `skill` tool are left untouched.
## Deterministic hints
Three one-line hints restore discoverability where it matters, still cheap:
- A request that reads like browser work (网页 / 浏览器 / 抓取 / 登录 / screenshot / browser …) → name the `b

rowser_*` tools (or `browser-skill` if the tools are absent).
- A `web_*` tool call fails → point at

`browser_session` → `browser_page` → `browser_inspect`.
- Every message is matched against all skil
l descriptions locally (CJK bigrams + latin words, common phrases filtered); up to three matches are
named with an 80-character description, once each per session.
## Install

Restart the harness afterwards; the bundle is loaded at boot.
## Verify
Start a new session and ask anything. The first turn should show the compact `<available_skills>` in
dex, one line per skill, and `skill_list query=简历` should return `resume-builder`.
## Limitations
- The 28-character clause is a truncation, not a summary; a few skills need `skill_list query=` or `

skill` to be understood.
- Selection via `skill_pick` is optional and per session.
- A session that
already carried the full catalog still shows it, plus the shipped plugin's "no skills available" cor

rection. Start a fresh session for a clean slate.
- If a preset registered `skill` in the agent's ow
n layer, registration fails and the plugin degrades to "picker tools available, full catalog unchang
yer, registration fails and the plugin degrades to "picker tools available, full catalog unchanged".

`index.js` is a single Host plugin, no build step. Run the self-check from inside the installed pack
age, so module resolution reaches the harness's own `@deepseek-ai/*` packages:
